skills.title: Programming foundations
skills.lesson: A variable stores a value. A branch selects a path. A loop repeats work. Trace a program one statement at a time and check boundary cases. Functions make inputs, outputs and responsibilities explicit.

skills.title: Collections & complexity
skills.lesson: Lists preserve order. Sets enforce uniqueness. Hash maps offer average constant-time lookup, with collision-dependent worst cases. A nested full scan over n inputs often costs O(n²). Choose a structure based on operations and memory.

skills.title: Kotlin & null safety
skills.lesson: Use val for a read-only reference and var for reassignment. Nullable types use ?. A safe call returns null for a null receiver; ?: supplies a fallback. !! can throw. Prefer immutable state and explicit types at boundaries.

skills.title: Android state & storage
skills.lesson: Compose renders state. ViewModels survive configuration changes but not process death. Persist durable data in Room. Use transactions for related writes. Collect flows with lifecycle awareness. Keep blocking work off the main thread.

skills.title: Probability & evidence
skills.lesson: Bayes rule combines a prior with likelihoods. Posterior odds equal prior odds times a likelihood ratio. A single correct guess does not prove mastery. Distinguish uncertainty in an estimate from evidence of low skill.

skills.title: ML evaluation
skills.lesson: Separate training, validation and test data. Fit preprocessing only on training data. Accuracy may hide class imbalance; precision measures correctness of positive predictions and recall measures recovered positives. Data leakage inflates results.

skills.title: Tensors & quantisation
skills.lesson: A tensor has shape, dtype and layout. Matrix multiplication contracts shared dimensions. INT4 weights reduce raw weight storage relative to FP32 by roughly eight times, before scales and metadata. Quantisation must be checked for quality loss.

skills.title: ARM inference deployment
skills.lesson: Export a model using the runtime-compatible toolchain. PTE execution uses delegated operators and fallbacks. XNNPACK targets the CPU. Measure time to first token, decode throughput, peak memory and sustained thermals on actual hardware. NPU use requires a compatible backend and device support.

questions.prompt: x starts at 2. Repeat x = x + 3 twice. What is x?
questions.explanation: Two updates give 2 → 5 → 8.

questions.prompt: Which input best checks the boundary of age >= 18?
questions.explanation: 17 fails and 18 passes at the threshold.

questions.prompt: A pure function should return the same result for…
options: The same input, without side effects
questions.explanation: Pure functions depend on explicit input and do not change external state.

questions.prompt: A loop visits indices 0 until 3. How many visits?
questions.explanation: The indices are 0, 1, 2; the upper bound is exclusive.

questions.prompt: Average lookup complexity of a well-behaved hash map?
questions.explanation: With distributed hashes and controlled load, lookup is average O(1).

questions.prompt: Which collection naturally removes duplicate IDs?
questions.explanation: A set enforces uniqueness.

questions.prompt: Two nested loops each scan all n elements. Complexity?
questions.explanation: n outer iterations times n inner iterations gives n² work.

questions.prompt: Binary search requires which useful property?
questions.explanation: Sorted order lets each comparison discard half the search interval.

questions.prompt: What does name?.length return when name is null?
questions.explanation: A safe call skips evaluation and returns null.

questions.prompt: val names = mutableListOf(1). Can names.add(2) work?
questions.explanation: val fixes the reference; the referenced object can still be mutable.

questions.prompt: Which gives 0 when nullable count is null?
questions.explanation: The Elvis operator supplies a fallback for null.

questions.prompt: Which operation risks a null pointer exception?
questions.explanation: !! asserts non-null and throws if the value is null.

questions.prompt: What normally survives rotation but not process death?
questions.explanation: A ViewModel is retained across configuration changes, not process death.

questions.prompt: How should answer and mastery writes remain atomic?
questions.explanation: A transaction commits related changes together or rolls them back.

questions.prompt: Where should blocking model generation run?
questions.explanation: Blocking inference would freeze rendering and input on the main thread.

questions.prompt: What should drive a Compose screen?
questions.explanation: Compose recomposes UI from observable state.

questions.prompt: A correct answer may be a guess. What follows?
questions.explanation: Evidence changes a probability without proving certainty.

questions.prompt: For independent fair coin flips, probability of two heads?
questions.explanation: Multiply independent probabilities: 1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4.

questions.prompt: Bayesian inference combines likelihood with…
questions.explanation: The prior and likelihood produce a posterior after normalization.

questions.prompt: P(A)=0.2. What is P(not A)?
questions.explanation: An event and its complement sum to 1.

questions.prompt: When should a scaler be fitted?
questions.explanation: Fitting on test data leaks held-out information.

questions.prompt: Recall is…
questions.explanation: Recall measures how many actual positives were found.

questions.prompt: 99% negatives: always predicting negative gives 99% accuracy. Is that enough?
options: No, inspect recall and class-specific metrics
questions.explanation: Accuracy masks failure to detect the rare positive class.

questions.prompt: Which set should guide hyperparameter choices?
questions.explanation: Use validation for tuning and reserve a final test set for evaluation.

questions.prompt: (2 × 3) matrix times (3 × 4) matrix has shape…
questions.explanation: Contract the shared dimension 3; keep outer dimensions 2 and 4.

questions.prompt: Raw INT4 weights versus FP32 need roughly…
questions.explanation: 4 bits instead of 32 gives 1/8 raw storage; scales and metadata add overhead.

questions.prompt: What must be checked after quantisation?
questions.explanation: Smaller precision may affect quality; latency gains depend on supported kernels.

questions.prompt: A tensor dtype describes…
questions.explanation: The dtype specifies how tensor elements are represented, such as float32 or int8.

questions.prompt: XNNPACK primarily targets which hardware?
questions.explanation: XNNPACK is a CPU inference backend.

questions.prompt: What supports a real offline inference claim?
options: Generation on the target phone in airplane mode
questions.explanation: Verify actual local generation with radios disconnected and record evidence.

questions.prompt: Why measure sustained generation as well as one short run?
questions.explanation: Device heat and power policies can reduce sustained throughput.

questions.prompt: A CPU benchmark proves NPU acceleration?
options: No, backend execution needs separate evidence
questions.explanation: Quantisation or speed alone does not identify the executing backend.

questions.prompt: Which condition accepts 10 but rejects 9?
questions.explanation: An inclusive lower bound includes the threshold itself.

questions.prompt: A loop starts at i=1 and doubles i while i<8. Values processed?
questions.explanation: The condition is checked before each iteration; 8 fails i<8.

questions.prompt: Why pass a dependency as a function argument?
options: It makes the dependency explicit and testable
questions.explanation: Explicit dependencies reduce hidden state and let a caller control inputs.

questions.prompt: Which test best checks a sum function on an empty list?
questions.explanation: Boundary behavior should be specified and checked, not guessed.

questions.prompt: Which structure supports first-in, first-out processing?
questions.explanation: A queue removes items in arrival order.

questions.prompt: Halving a sorted search space each step takes roughly…
questions.explanation: After k halvings the remaining range is n/2^k, giving logarithmic search steps.

questions.prompt: Why is hash-map O(1) lookup described as average?
questions.explanation: Hash distribution and collisions affect the number of entries examined.

questions.prompt: A single pass over n elements with constant work per element costs…
questions.explanation: The work grows linearly with the number of visited elements.

questions.prompt: Which Kotlin type explicitly permits null?
questions.explanation: The question-mark suffix marks a nullable type.

questions.prompt: What does val prohibit directly?
questions.explanation: A read-only reference is different from a deeply immutable object.

questions.prompt: Which expression safely yields a nullable string's length or 0?
questions.explanation: The safe call handles a null receiver and Elvis supplies the default.

questions.prompt: Why prefer a checked nullable branch over repeated !! assertions?
options: It states and handles the null case explicitly
questions.explanation: Explicit null handling makes the precondition and alternate path visible.

questions.prompt: Where should durable assessment evidence be stored?
questions.explanation: Persistent storage survives process termination and app restart.

questions.prompt: What should happen if one write in a scoring transaction fails?
questions.explanation: Atomic updates must not leave answers and mastery inconsistent.

questions.prompt: A blocked main thread most directly harms…
questions.explanation: Android's UI thread handles events and rendering work.

questions.prompt: Why should UI state collection respect lifecycle?
options: To avoid unnecessary background UI collection
questions.explanation: Lifecycle-aware collection limits UI work when the screen is inactive.

questions.prompt: A valid probability must lie…
questions.explanation: Probabilities include impossibility at 0 and certainty at 1.

questions.prompt: A test has guess probability. Why retain a posterior below 1 after success?
options: Success can occur without full knowledge
questions.explanation: Guessing means a correct response is evidence, not certainty.

questions.prompt: If two events are not independent, multiplying their marginal probabilities is…
questions.explanation: Use a conditional probability when dependence matters.

questions.prompt: What does a likelihood describe in Bayesian inference?
options: How probable evidence is under a hypothesis
questions.explanation: Likelihood evaluates observed evidence assuming a particular hypothesis.

questions.prompt: Which metric measures correctness among predicted positives?
questions.explanation: Precision is TP divided by TP plus FP.

questions.prompt: Training and test splits contain the same person's near-duplicate records. Risk?
questions.explanation: Correlated duplicates can reveal held-out information and inflate measured performance.

questions.prompt: Which comparison best supports a model-quality claim?
options: Held-out evaluation on the same declared task
questions.explanation: Consistent held-out evaluation supports meaningful quality comparisons.

questions.prompt: A classifier misses most rare positive cases. Which metric exposes that?
questions.explanation: Low recall reveals that many actual positives were missed.

questions.prompt: Which multiplication has compatible inner dimensions?
questions.explanation: The contracted dimensions must match: 3 and 3.

questions.prompt: Why can a quantized file exceed the raw weight-bit estimate?
options: Scales, metadata and other tensors add overhead
questions.explanation: A deployment artifact includes more than packed weight values.

questions.prompt: Which change can increase KV-cache memory?
questions.explanation: More cached token positions require more key/value storage for the same model and dtype.

questions.prompt: A faster quantized model with unusable answer quality should be…
questions.explanation: Latency and memory improvements must be weighed against task quality.

questions.prompt: A PTE artifact should be paired with…
options: Its compatible tokenizer and runtime version
questions.explanation: Token IDs, model metadata and runtime operators must agree.

questions.prompt: What is time to first token intended to capture?
options: Delay before the first generated token
questions.explanation: Define whether load and tokenization are included when reporting first-token latency.

questions.prompt: Why retain model hashes with performance records?
options: They identify which exact artifact was measured
questions.explanation: A hash links a measurement to a specific model artifact.

questions.prompt: A post-run memory snapshot proves true peak memory?
options: No; sampling or profiling during execution is needed
questions.explanation: A snapshot can miss a transient allocation peak.
